description: Αρχείο Γεωγραφικής Απόδοσης Γεωδαιτικών Σημείων Αναφοράς (τριγωνομετρικών στάσεων και reper) is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Τμήμα Τοπογραφίας. Setul de date geospațiale conține puncte de referință geodezice, cum ar fi punctele de plecare spațio-temporale cu altitudinile și poziția lor și opririle trigonometrice cu coordonatele lor. Coverage: Τμήμα Τοπογραφίας. The portal shows the English title as "Registro de rendimiento geográfico de los puntos de referencia geodésicos (paradas trigonométricas y reper)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Τμήμα Τοπογραφίας. Its keywords include Από μετάπτωση, Τριγωνομετρικέσ στάσεισ, repository.data.gov.gr, Γεωδαιτικά σημεία αναφοράσ. The listing shows 3 download or service links in DWG, ZIP, XML. The listing shows 2026-02-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
